4279-6248-7192--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-6248-7192--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Grave Venerations, Phenomenon Investigators and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Phenomenon Investigators ability, creating a 2/2 Horror creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Grave Venerations triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2085-2645-3430-4717.easyPrerequisites: Kelpie Guide doesn't have summoning sickness.
2085-2645-3430-4717.description:
Activate City of Traitors by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, untapping City of Traitors
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Kelpie Guide.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1339-1829-1832-2034.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1829-1832-2034.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}
When the Insect dies, Vindictive Vampire triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat.

1651-4231-4732-5261-7810.notablePrerequisites: You control another artifact or creature.
1651-4231-4732-5261-7810.description:
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it to cast a copy of Deadly Dispute without paying its mana cost.
As an additional cost to cast Deadly Dispute, sacrifice a creature or artifact.
Resolve Deadly Dispute, drawing two cards and creating two Food tokens, two Clue tokens, and two Treasure tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Tippy-Toe.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them to add {2}.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two untapped artifacts you control to untap Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

339-677-6798-7730.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2595-4613-5446-7150.notablePrerequisites: You control two additional creatures, one of which must have a +1/+1 counter on it and hasn't used Kirol's ability this turn.
2595-4613-5446-7150.description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it.
Cast Esika's Chariot by paying {3}{G}.
When Esika's Chariot enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it using Kirol's ability by tapping two creatures you control, copying Esika's Chariot's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Esika's Chariot's trigger, creating two 2/2 Cat creature tokens, which each enter with a +1/+1 counter on them due to Combine Guildmage.
Repeat from step 4, using one of the Cats to activate Kirol's ability, and then tapping both Cats.

152-2034-6741.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four multicolored permanents.
152-2034-6741.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of Infinite Guideline Station that is a 1/1 Soldier.
Put the Infinite Guideline Station token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Infinite Guideline Station token enters, it triggers, creating a tapped 2/2 Robot artifact creature token for each multicolored permanent you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar four times by sacrificing four Robots, adding eight {C}.
Repeat.

1052-2921-3175.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

3259-4742-5722.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls no creatures.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature other than Wasitora.
3259-4742-5722.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent who controls no creatures using Wasitora and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Wasitora.
Resolve the Wasitora trigger, creating a 3/3 Cat Dragon creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Cat Dragon, then causing you to untap all creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat damage.

643-5310-6798-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
643-5310-6798-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

104-1496-3490-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-1496-3490-5231.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

2639-3254-3859-4050.manaNeeded: {4}{G/W}{B}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2639-3254-3859-4050.description:
Cast Nethroi either from your hand or from the command zone for its mutate cost by paying {4}{G/W}{B}{B}, putting it under a non-Human creature you control.
Nethroi triggers, returning Cavern Harpy and Mitotic Slime from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cavern Harpy enters, it triggers, returning Nethroi from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Cavern Harpy and Mitotic Slime, adding {B}{B}.
When Mitotic Slime dies, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Oozes, adding {1}{G/W}.
When the Oozes die, they trigger, creating four 1/1 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Oozes, adding {3}.
Repeat.
2639-3254-3859-4050.notes: During step 2, you can recur other creatures with suitable powers. This will allow you to forego sacrificing that many Oozes in step 8, netting infinite mana and creature tokens. If you have infinite mana and Oozes, you can then forego reanimating Mitotic Slime and reanimate anything else with a suitable power instead.

703-4050-4394-4452.description:
Cast Everquill Phoenix for its mutate cost by paying {3}{R}, mutating it over or under a non-Human creature you control.
Everquill Phoenix triggers, creating a Feather artifact token.
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two copies of the Feather token that are 3/3 Dragon creatures.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Astral Dragon, adding {1}.
Activate a Feather by paying {1} and sacrificing it, returning Astral Dragon from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.

3457-4235-4747.notablePrerequisites:
Seeker of Skybreak and Alena do not have summoning sickness.
You had a creature with power 3 or greater enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
3457-4235-4747.description:
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Alena.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Alena.
Repeat.

5330-5365-5445.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue.
Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to Lonis.
5330-5365-5445.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis' second ability and Tarrian's Soulcleaver trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on any other creature you control.
Resolve the Tarrian's Soulcleaver trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Atog ability from step 1, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

947-1132-1305-3129.description:
Cast Heaven Sent by paying {U}{R}.
Widespread Thieving triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{R}.
Resolve Heaven Sent, choosing to have it enter the battlefield with three chapter counters on it due to its read ahead ability.
Heaven Sent's third chapter ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent, and causing you to draw seven cards if an opponent has 0 or less life, or otherwise exile Heaven Sent with the ability to play it this turn.
If Heaven Sent was exiled this way, repeat until Heaven Sent is not exiled.

1634-2553-3858.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers.
Holding priority, cast White Sun's Zenith by paying {5}{W}{W}{W}, creating five 1/1 Cat creature tokens and shuffling it into your library.
When the Cats enter the battlefield, Devilish Valet triggers that many times, doubling its power that many times, causing its power to be at least 32 until end of turn.
Resolve the Mayael's Aria trigger, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain 10 life and win the game.

2781-3086-3603.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, blinking Lagrella.
Lagrella leaves the battlefield, causing Felidar Guardian to return to the battlefield from exile.
Lagrella and Felidar Guardian's enter-the-battlefield abilities trigger.
Resolve the Lagrella trigger, exiling Felidar Guarrdian until Lagrella leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Lagrella.
Repeat from step 2.

518-1640.notablePrerequisites:
You control an indestructible creature that has Pariah's Shield attached to it.
You have a way to deal damage to the indestructible creature.
518-1640.description:
Cast Arcbond by paying {2}{R}, targeting the indestructible creature with Pariah's Shield attached.
Deal damage to the indestructible creature.
The creature triggers, dealing that much damage to each other creature and each player, with the damage that would be dealt to you instead being dealt to the indestructible creature due to Pariah's Shield.
Repeat step 3.

2034-4681-4881.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Activated Sleeper by paying {2}{B}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
Activated Sleeper enters the battlefield, targeting Karmic Guide.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Activated Sleeper, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Activated Sleeper trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, targeting Activated Sleeper.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

2034-2290-3097-4186.notablePrerequisites:
Dean of the Root.
Spike Feeder has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
2034-2290-3097-4186.description:
Activate Spike Feeder's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to gain two life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Squirrel token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1424-2178-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff and Presence of Gond attached to the same creature.
The creature does not have summoning sickness.
1424-2178-4050.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Elf Warrior token, adding one mana of any color.
The creature with Thornbite Staff equipped triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

2757-3179-4770.notablePrerequisites: You control a basic land that can produce {W}.
2757-3179-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {W}.
When you cast Whitemane Lion, Oketra's Monument triggers, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token with vigilance.
Resolve Whitemane Lion.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it triggers.
In response, activate Earthcraft by tapping Whitemane Lion, untapping a basic land you control that can produce {W}.
Resolve Whitemane Lion's ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {W}.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite Warrior tokens, you may activate Earthcraft any number of times.

2757-3600-3750.description:
Cast Tempt with Vengeance by paying {6}{R}, creating at least six 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping an Elemental token, untapping a basic Mountain you control.
Activate the Mountain by tapping it, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2 five additional times.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and giving you an extra combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.
